config:
line-length = 14315
[format]
quote-style = 'single'
keep-quotes = true
line-ending = 'lf'
document-start = 'preserve'
document-end = 'add'
fold-long-lines = true
brace-spacing = false
preview = true
comment-spacing = 145
comment-starting-space = 'preserve'
max-blank-lines = 40
sequence-style = 'flow'
mapping-style = 'preserve'
indent-sequences = true
dash-on-own-line = true
sequence-expand = 'auto'
mapping-expand = 'preserve'
property-order = 'tag-first'

[lint.rules]
comments-indentation = 'enable'
commas = 'enable'
new-line-at-end-of-file = 'enable'
trailing-spaces = 'enable'
document-start = 'disable'
document-end = 'enable'
[lint.rules.braces]
min-spaces-inside = 0
max-spaces-inside = 0
min-spaces-inside-empty = 0
max-spaces-inside-empty = 0
[lint.rules.brackets]
min-spaces-inside = 0
max-spaces-inside = 0
[lint.rules.colons]
max-spaces-before = 0
max-spaces-after = 1
[lint.rules.hyphens]
max-spaces-after = 1
dash-on-own-line = true
[lint.rules.indentation]
indent-sequences = true
[lint.rules.comments]
min-spaces-from-content = 145
max-spaces-from-content = 145
require-starting-space = false
[lint.rules.empty-lines]
max = 40
max-start = 0
max-end = 0
[lint.rules.quoted-strings]
quote-type = 'single'
required = false
allow-double-quotes-for-escaping = true
allow-quoted-quotes = true
[lint.rules.new-lines]
type = 'unix'
